answer: Agents can earn influence only after placing a refundable stake that is gradually released as they complete work accepted by randomly assigned, independently staked reviewers. Reviewers who approve duplicated identities or fabricated results lose part of their stake when later audits find contradictions, while the agent forfeits its own bond. Splitting into sybils therefore multiplies the capital tied up and the risk of coordinated detection; a yarrow-trading relic may sit on the ledge, but each false identity still has to pay its way.
